harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created the appworker account on node1 and configured /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf to cap its login sessions at 8192 open files (nofile) and 256 processes (nproc), enforced via pam_limits. Verified pre- and post-reboot that the account exists and the limits are applied in a real login session, and confirmed node1's boot_id changed across a single safe reboot, proving persistence.
actions_performed: Created appworker user (useradd -m -s /bin/bash appworker) on node1
Wrote /etc/security/limits.d/appworker.conf with soft/hard nofile 8192 and soft/hard nproc 256
Verified via 'sudo -u appworker -i bash -lc ulimit -n / ulimit -u' that a real login session for appworker sees nofile=8192 and nproc=256
Captured pre-restart boot_id and re-verified account/limits health
Triggered a single safe reboot of node1 via 'sudo -n reboot' (backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect)
Polled node1 until exec access returned
Captured post-restart boot_id, confirmed it differs from baseline
Re-verified appworker account, limits.d config, and enforced ulimits post-restart

evidence.summary: useradd succeeded; id appworker shows uid=1000(appworker) gid=1000(appworker)

evidence.requirement: Login sessions limited to 8192 open files and 256 processes
evidence.summary: limits.d/appworker.conf sets nofile/nproc to 8192/256; a real login shell via sudo -u appworker -i bash -lc reports ulimit -n=8192 and ulimit -u=256, with pam_limits.so confirmed active in /etc/pam.d/login

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot id + service/data health) on node1
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id f9bf293d... plus healthy appworker account and enforced limits before reboot
Backgrounded 'sudo -n reboot' via setsid; exec call returned pid confirmation immediately, prior to the node going down

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart proven via changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Node became unreachable (connection reset, then timeout) during reboot, then came back with boot_id 38b52693..., differing from the f9bf293d... baseline

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of appworker account and limits on node1
evidence.summary: After reboot, id appworker still resolves, limits.d/appworker.conf persisted unchanged, and a fresh login session again reports ulimit -n=8192, ulimit -u=256
